messages.author: 8fab8f2ebe87fd24
messages.subject: Issue deploying shiny app
parts:
Everytime I try to run my app I get this error message. I saw another post here that said it was likely due to an issue with the BiocGenerics package, but their issue seemed to be fixed when R released an update on the 20th and mine is still not working. 

This is the error message I am receiving:

> shiny::runApp('R')

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:3655
Found more than one class "connection" in cache; using the first, from namespace 'BiocGenerics' 

Any ideas how I can fix this?

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Issue deploying shiny app
parts:
Hi Lindsey,
It sounds like you are having an issue running a shiny application locally?  Is that the case? If so that isn't really an issue for shinyapps.io and more of a shiny question.  The discussion group you probably want is: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/shiny-discuss 

I don't know BioConductor well enough, but the message you see there looks like a warning not an error.  It is just informing you where it is using that package from.

-Tareef
